# Future trend & significance map — sandbox (reads product **B**)

Standalone prototype for the **future-projection trend / significance map** described in
**CR-117** / **CR-119** dispatch
[`2026-06-12_publish-B-recommendation.md`](../../playbook/handovers/climateRationale/dispatches/2026-06-12_publish-B-recommendation.md).
It is **entirely separate** from `obs_month_overlay.qmd` — its own page, its own data layer — so
it can iterate without touching the CR-097/CR-116 sandbox or the production notebook.

Sources: **B** `ensemble_season_trends.parquet` — across-GCM ensemble `mean`/`sd`, `stat ∈ {value_slope,
value_decade}` (drives the Trend + Inter-model variability metrics); and **A**
`ensemble_season_timeseries.parquet` — per-year `mean` + `mean_anomaly`, aggregated to a 20-yr
period-mean (drives the Climatology + Anomaly metrics; Anomaly = future − 1995-2014 baseline).
Both iso3-first sorted / prunable.

```{ojs}
md`<details class="help-callout">
<summary>About this section — methodology & open caveats</summary>

This map renders the **ensemble-mean trend** of a NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 variable over a 20-year future window,
per admin1. Two open methodology points (relayed to the pipeline session, not yet confirmed in the
published file):

1. **Per-GCM-then-ensemble — CONFIRMED.** The slope is fit on *each GCM's* series (fit_keys include
   \`model\`), then mean/sd taken across GCMs (§3.7.1). Inter-model trend spread (\`sd\`) is preserved.
   Standing rule \`feedback_ensembling-is-always-last\` holds.
2. **Significance = inter-model agreement (SNR proxy).** The pipeline dropped \`value_pval\`
   (mean-of-pvals is uninterpretable) and B ships \`value_slope\` + \`value_decade\` with an across-GCM
   \`mean\` **and inter-model \`sd\`**. The overlay fades any admin1 where **|trend| < σ** — the trend
   signal sits inside the inter-model spread → low model agreement. This is the Knutti & Sedláček
   (2013) signal-to-noise proxy for AR6 sign-agreement, the same convention the CR-116 period-maps
   use. NOTE: computed client-side from \`mean\`/\`sd\` — B has **no dedicated per-GCM agreement column
   yet** (verified across all 4 periods). If the pipeline later adds a true \`pct_gcms_sig\` /
   \`pct_sign_pos\` (CR-117), it supersedes this proxy 1:1.
`
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Data layer B (ensemble_season_trends): all stat rows for the country in one
// query per (country, period). iso3 = '<X>' prunes row-groups (B is iso3-first
// sorted); rest filters client-side. 404-safe → banner shows if B is absent.
trend_dataAll = {
  const iso3 = countrySel.iso3;
  const url = `${trendBase}/period=${periodSel}/baseline=1995-2014/variable=ensemble_season_trends.parquet`;
  const sql = `
    SELECT admin1_name, iso3, scenario, season, hazard, stat, mean, sd
    FROM read_parquet('${url}')
    WHERE iso3 = '${iso3}' AND admin1_name IS NOT NULL`;
  try {
    const rows = Array.from(await db_trends.query(sql));
    return { ok: true, rows };
  } catch (err) {
    return { ok: false, rows: [], error: (err && err.message) ? err.message : String(err) };
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Pivot the long-format cache to one record per admin1 for the active selection:
// { admin1_name -> { value_slope, value_decade, sd_<stat> } }
trendByAdmin = {
  const sel = trend_dataAll.rows.filter(r =>
    r.scenario === scenarioSel && r.season === seasonSel && r.hazard === hazardSel);
  const m = new Map();
  for (const r of sel) {
    if (!m.has(r.admin1_name)) m.set(r.admin1_name, {});
    const o = m.get(r.admin1_name);
    o[r.stat] = r.mean;
    o[`sd_${r.stat}`] = r.sd;
  }
  return m;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Product A (ensemble_season_timeseries) — period-mean climatology + future-vs-
// baseline anomaly per admin1, for the active selection. A.mean_anomaly is the
// per-year delta vs the 1995-2014 baseline, so avg over the 20 period-years
// gives the window climatology (avg mean) and its delta (avg mean_anomaly).
// Server-side GROUP BY caps the payload to ~one row per admin1. Re-queries on
// selection change; err-safe (returns empty Map → those metrics show no-data).
a_aggByAdmin = {
  if (!scenarioOptions.length) return new Map();   // B (hence selectors) not loaded yet
  const url = `${trendBase}/period=${periodSel}/baseline=1995-2014/variable=ensemble_season_timeseries.parquet`;
  const sql = `
    SELECT admin1_name, avg(mean) AS clim, avg(mean_anomaly) AS anom
    FROM read_parquet('${url}')
    WHERE iso3 = '${countrySel.iso3}' AND admin1_name IS NOT NULL
      AND scenario = '${scenarioSel}' AND season = '${seasonSel}' AND hazard = '${hazardSel}'
    GROUP BY admin1_name`;
  try {
    const rows = Array.from(await db_ts.query(sql));
    return new Map(rows.map(r => [r.admin1_name, { clim: r.clim, anom: r.anom }]));
  } catch (err) {
    return new Map();
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
// Variable-aware diverging palette: wet vars (PTOT/SPEI) positive=wetter=blue;
// temperature positive=warmer=red. value_pval would be sequential, but the radio
// only exposes slope/decade — pval drives the significance fade instead.
isWetVar = (hazardSel || "").startsWith("PTOT") || (hazardSel || "").startsWith("SPEI")

trendMap = {
  if (!trend_dataAll.ok) {
    return htl.html`<div class="trend-banner warn">
      <strong>Product B not reachable.</strong> <code>ensemble_season_trends.parquet</code> for
      period <code>${periodSel}</code> returned an error — most likely it isn't published to S3 yet
      (the pipeline session flagged it as in-progress on 2026-06-12). This scaffold lights up
      automatically once the key exists.<br><small>${trend_dataAll.error ?? ""}</small></div>`;
  }
  if (!trend_dataAll.rows.length)
    return htl.html`<div class="trend-banner warn">No B rows for <strong>${countrySel.name}</strong> / ${periodSel}.</div>`;

  const features = topojson.feature(topoA1, topoA1.objects["atlas_gaul24_a1_africa"]).features
    .filter(f => f.properties.iso3 === countrySel.iso3);
  if (!features.length) return htl.html`<p style="color:#c00">No admin1 geometry for ${countrySel.name}.</p>`;

  // Metric routing. Trend/σ ← B (trendByAdmin); Climatology/Anomaly ← A (a_aggByAdmin).
  const isSd    = metricSel.startsWith("Inter-model");
  const isClim  = metricSel.startsWith("Climatology");
  const isAnom  = metricSel.startsWith("Anomaly");
  const isTrend = metricSel.startsWith("Trend");
  const diverging = isTrend || isAnom;   // signed → diverging; σ/clim → sequential

  const getV = name => {
    if (isClim || isAnom) { const a = a_aggByAdmin.get(name); return a ? (isClim ? a.clim : a.anom) : undefined; }
    const o = trendByAdmin.get(name); if (!o) return undefined;
    return isSd ? o[`sd_${statSel}`] : o[statSel];
  };

  const vals = features.map(f => getV(f.properties.admin1_name)).filter(v => v != null);

  let colour, legendSwatches;
  if (diverging) {
    // Signed (trend / anomaly): variable-aware diverging (wet=blue+ / temp=red+).
    const absMax = d3.max(vals, Math.abs) || 1;
    const sc = d3.scaleLinear().domain([-absMax, absMax]).range([0, 1]);
    colour = v => v == null ? "#ddd" : d3.interpolateRdBu(isWetVar ? sc(v) : 1 - sc(v));
    legendSwatches = htl.html`
      <span><span class="swatch" style="background:${d3.interpolateRdBu(isWetVar ? 1 : 0)}"></span>${isWetVar ? "wetter / increasing" : "warmer / increasing"}</span>
      <span><span class="swatch" style="background:${d3.interpolateRdBu(0.5)}"></span>~no change</span>
      <span><span class="swatch" style="background:${d3.interpolateRdBu(isWetVar ? 0 : 1)}"></span>${isWetVar ? "drier / decreasing" : "cooler / decreasing"}</span>
      <span><span class="swatch" style="background:#ddd"></span>no data</span>
      ${isTrend && showSignif ? htl.html`<span style="opacity:.55">faded = low agreement (|trend| &lt; σ; Knutti &amp; Sedláček SNR proxy)</span>` : ""}`;
  } else if (isSd) {
    // σ ≥ 0 → neutral Purples (never reads as wet/warm). Darker = more disagreement.
    const hi = d3.max(vals) || 1;
    const sc = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, hi]).range([0.12, 0.95]);
    colour = v => v == null ? "#ddd" : d3.interpolatePurples(sc(v));
    legendSwatches = htl.html`
      <span><span class="swatch" style="background:${d3.interpolatePurples(0.12)}"></span>low σ (models agree)</span>
      <span><span class="swatch" style="background:${d3.interpolatePurples(0.95)}"></span>high σ (models disagree)</span>
      <span><span class="swatch" style="background:#ddd"></span>no data</span>`;
  } else {
    // Climatology (absolute value, ≥ 0): variable-aware sequential — wet=Blues, else=YlOrRd.
    const lo = d3.min(vals) ?? 0, hi = d3.max(vals) ?? 1;
    const sc = d3.scaleLinear().domain([lo, hi]).range([0.1, 0.92]);
    const ramp = isWetVar ? d3.interpolateBlues : d3.interpolateYlOrRd;
    colour = v => v == null ? "#ddd" : ramp(sc(v));
    legendSwatches = htl.html`
      <span><span class="swatch" style="background:${ramp(0.1)}"></span>low</span>
      <span><span class="swatch" style="background:${ramp(0.92)}"></span>high</span>
      <span><span class="swatch" style="background:#ddd"></span>no data</span>`;
  }

  // Agreement fade only applies to the trend layer (σ is the spread itself; A metrics carry no per-stat σ here).
  const fadeFor = f => {
    if (!isTrend || !showSignif) return 1;
    const o = trendByAdmin.get(f.properties.admin1_name) ?? {};
    const v = o[statSel], sd = o[`sd_${statSel}`];
    return (v != null && sd != null && Math.abs(v) >= sd) ? 1 : 0.3;
  };

  const fc = { type: "FeatureCollection", features };
  const width = 720, height = 560;

  const plot = Plot.plot({
    width, height,
    projection: { type: "mercator", domain: fc },
    marks: [
      Plot.geo(features, {
        fill: f => colour(getV(f.properties.admin1_name)),
        fillOpacity: fadeFor,
        stroke: "#fff", strokeWidth: 0.5,
        title: f => {
          const name = f.properties.admin1_name;
          const o = trendByAdmin.get(name) ?? {};
          const a = a_aggByAdmin.get(name) ?? {};
          const v = o[statSel], sd = o[`sd_${statSel}`];
          const robust = (v != null && sd != null && Math.abs(v) >= sd);
          const cur = getV(name);
          return `${name}`
               + `\n${metricSel}: ${cur != null ? cur.toFixed(3) : "—"}`
               + `\n— trend (${statSel}): ${v != null ? v.toFixed(3) : "—"} · σ: ${sd != null ? sd.toFixed(3) : "—"}`
               + ` (${v != null && sd != null ? (robust ? "robust" : "low agreement") : "—"})`
               + `\n— climatology: ${a.clim != null ? a.clim.toFixed(2) : "—"} · Δ vs baseline: ${a.anom != null ? a.anom.toFixed(2) : "—"}`;
        },
      }),
    ],
  });

  const unit = statSel === "value_decade" ? "per decade" : "per year";
  const metricLabel =
      isSd   ? `inter-model σ of trend ${unit}`
    : isClim ? `climatology — 20-yr period-mean value (variable units)`
    : isAnom ? `anomaly — future − 1995-2014 baseline (variable units)`
    :          `trend ${unit} (ensemble mean across GCMs)`;
  return htl.html`<div>
    ${plot}
    <div class="trend-legend">${legendSwatches}</div>
    <p style="font-size:.8rem;color:#666;margin-top:.4rem">
      ${hazardSel} · ${scenarioSel} · ${seasonSel} · ${periodSel} · ${metricLabel}
    </p>
  </div>`;
}
```

# Future projections — time series (CR-notebook replica)

The per-year line + inter-model **17–83 % "likely" ribbon**, mirroring the production
notebook's Future Projections chart (`timeseries_futureProjections`). Country aggregate
(`admin1_name IS NULL`), continuous 1995→2100: historical baseline + the selected SSP.
Toggle anomaly vs absolute and the ribbon in the controls above.

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// SSP-keyed colour (IPCC AR6 convention).
sspColor = ({ ssp126: "#1d3557", ssp245: "#e76f51", ssp370: "#d62828", ssp585: "#6a040f" })[scenarioSel] ?? "#264653"
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Product A per-year country-aggregate series for the selection: baseline file
// (scenario='historical', 1995-2014) UNION the 4 future period files (selected
// SSP). q17/q83 are the CR-060 inter-model 17–83% percentile columns. iso3 = '<X>'
// prunes row-groups. Err-safe → empty array shows a banner.
a_timeseries = {
  if (!scenarioOptions.length) return [];
  const iso3 = countrySel.iso3;
  const base = `${trendBase}/period=`;
  const tail = `/baseline=1995-2014/variable=ensemble_season_timeseries.parquet`;
  const cols = `year, mean, mean_anomaly, q17, q83, q17_anomaly, q83_anomaly`;
  const filt = (scn) => `WHERE iso3='${iso3}' AND admin1_name IS NULL AND scenario='${scn}' AND season='${seasonSel}' AND hazard='${hazardSel}'`;
  const baseSql = `SELECT ${cols} FROM read_parquet('${base}1995-2014${tail}') ${filt("historical")}`;
  const futSql = ["2021-2040","2041-2060","2061-2080","2081-2100"]
    .map(p => `SELECT ${cols} FROM read_parquet('${base}${p}${tail}') ${filt(scenarioSel)}`)
    .join(" UNION ALL ");
  try {
    return Array.from(await db_ts2.query(`${baseSql} UNION ALL ${futSql} ORDER BY year`));
  } catch (err) {
    return [];
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
tsPlot = {
  if (!a_timeseries.length)
    return htl.html`<div class="trend-banner warn">No A time-series rows for
      <strong>${countrySel.name}</strong> · ${scenarioSel} · ${seasonSel} · ${hazardSel}.</div>`;
  const anom = showAnomalyTs;
  const yv = anom ? "mean_anomaly" : "mean";
  const lo = anom ? "q17_anomaly" : "q17";
  const hi = anom ? "q83_anomaly" : "q83";
  const data = a_timeseries;
  return Plot.plot({
    width: 760, height: 380, marginLeft: 64, marginRight: 20, marginTop: 24, marginBottom: 40,
    x: { tickFormat: "d", label: "Year", ticks: 8 },
    y: { grid: true, nice: true, label: anom ? `${hazardSel} anomaly (vs 1995–2014)` : `${hazardSel}` },
    marks: [
      anom ? Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: "#999", strokeDasharray: [5] }) : null,
      showRibbon ? Plot.areaY(data, { x: "year", y1: hi, y2: lo, fill: sspColor, fillOpacity: 0.16 }) : null,
      Plot.line(data, { x: "year", y: yv, stroke: sspColor, strokeWidth: 1.6 }),
      Plot.dot(data, {
        x: "year", y: yv, fill: sspColor, r: 2, stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.6,
        tip: { channels: {
          year: { label: "Year", value: d => d3.format("d")(d.year) },
          value: { label: anom ? "Anomaly" : "Value", value: d => d[yv]?.toFixed(2) },
          band: { label: "17–83%", value: d => (d[lo] == null || d[hi] == null) ? "—" : `${d[lo].toFixed(2)} to ${d[hi].toFixed(2)}` },
        } },
      }),
    ].filter(Boolean),
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
md`<p style="font-size:.8rem;color:#666">${hazardSel} · ${scenarioSel} · ${seasonSel} · country aggregate · line = ensemble mean, band = inter-model 17–83% (AR6 "likely"). Historical 1995–2014 then the selected SSP.</p>`
```
